question: Asking a patient 'Do you understand how to take your medication?' is a reliable method to assess whether they have comprehended the drug counselling they received.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct. 'Do you understand?' is an unreliable comprehension check. The teach-back method is the standard: ask the patient to explain the regimen back to you. Correct comprehension gaps immediately. This technique significantly improves adherence in chronic disease.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Incorrect. 'Do you understand?' invites a yes/no response and almost always elicits 'yes' regardless of actual comprehension (social desirability bias). The teach-back method — asking the patient to explain in their own words how they will take the medication — is the validated approach to assess true understanding.
